All data in transit is encrypted using industry-standard SSL/TLS protocols (HTTPS). Your data is protected while being transmitted to and from our servers.
Sensitive client data (documents, invoices, personal information) is encrypted at rest on our secure servers. Only authorised staff can decrypt and access.
Servers are hosted on enterprise-grade infrastructure with redundant backups, firewalls, and DDoS protection. Regular security patches and updates applied.
Role-based access control ensures only authorised team members can view specific client data. Admin logs track all data access.
We collect personal data only when you provide it (contact forms, portal registration, enquiries).
We collect business data only for service delivery (NDIS documents, website content, payroll details).
Cookies are used for session management and analytics (Google Analytics). You can opt out anytime.
No unnecessary personal data is collected or stored.
Client data is stored on Australian-based servers (where possible) for compliance.
Data is backed up daily to secure offsite locations.
Backup copies are tested monthly for integrity and recoverability.
Redundant systems ensure your data is safe even if primary servers fail.
Only SOL staff involved in your project can access your data.
Third-party integrations (e.g., Stripe for payments) access only necessary data.
Admin access is logged and audited regularly.
No data is accessed without documented business reason.
Active project data is kept throughout service delivery and 1 year after completion.
Financial records (invoices, receipts) are kept for 7 years (Australian tax requirement).
Training records (certificates, progress) are kept indefinitely if you request.
You can request deletion of data at any time (within legal compliance limits).
We never sell, rent, or share your data with marketing companies.
We never share personal data publicly or on social media without explicit permission.
Case studies are published only with written client approval.
Integrations with payment processors (Stripe) share only transaction data.
SOL understands that NDIS providers hold sensitive participant information. Our processes are designed to meet NDIS Commission expectations:
NDIS provider data is isolated from other service data.
Access to participant information is restricted to NDIS project team only.
Data breaches involving NDIS information are reported to the NDIS Commission as required.
Documentation (policies, procedures, audit trails) is maintained for NDIS compliance audits.
If we detect unauthorized data access or breach, we immediately isolate affected systems and stop the breach.
We assess which data was accessed and which clients are affected within 24 hours.
You will be notified immediately by phone and email, with details of what happened and what to do.
If required by law (e.g., Privacy Act, NDIS Commission), we will report to relevant authorities.
We provide free credit monitoring or other support as appropriate. We also implement changes to prevent recurrence.
SOL complies with Australian privacy law. Your personal information is handled according to the Australian Privacy Principles.
For NDIS-related data, we follow NDIS Commission rules on provider obligations and participant privacy.
We send marketing emails only to opted-in contacts. You can unsubscribe anytime.
Our website and service portal comply with Australian e-commerce requirements for secure transactions.
Can I see what data SOL has about me?
Yes. You have the right to request a copy of your personal data. Email info@solbusinessconsultant.com.au with 'Data Access Request' in the subject. We will provide information within 30 days.
Can I ask SOL to delete my data?
Yes, with limitations. We must keep financial records for 7 years (tax law). Training certificates may be kept on request. Contact us to discuss your specific situation.
Absolutely. If any personal data is incorrect, let us know and we will update it immediately. Email info@solbusinessconsultant.com.au with corrections.
Who can see my client portal?
Only you (and your authorized team members if granted access). SOL staff involved in your project can see project data only.
What if I don't agree to data practices?
You can opt out of non-essential data collection (e.g., marketing emails). However, essential data (payment, service delivery) is required for service use.
How do I make a privacy complaint?
Contact us at info@solbusinessconsultant.com.au with 'Privacy Complaint' in the subject. If unsatisfied, you can lodge a complaint with the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC).

What if I need something not listed in my package?
We offer hourly consulting at $150/hr for additional work. Let us know what you need and we'll provide a quote.
Can I change or cancel my service?

Yes. For setup services (NDIS, website, business registration), cancellation is possible within the first week with a pro-rata refund. For ongoing services, 2 weeks' notice ends the engagement with final billing.
What if I'm not satisfied with the service?
We offer a 14-day satisfaction guarantee for new services. If you're not satisfied, we'll revise the work or issue a full refund. Contact us immediately if there are issues.
Yes. For services over $3,000, we offer 2-3 payment installments. Discuss options when receiving your quote.

Yes, but timeline may adjust. Email us with the additional scope and we'll provide an updated quote and timeline.
What happens after my service ends?
You keep all deliverables (websites, documentation, accounts, etc.). We can discuss ongoing support or maintenance packages if needed.

Not sure which tier you have? Check your contract or invoice, or email us at info@solbusinessconsultant.com.au with your service reference.
What if I have an urgent issue outside business hours?

For true emergencies, call our main line and leave a detailed message. Enterprise clients have after-hours emergency contact details in their portal. Standard clients should email and we will respond first thing the next business day.
How long does a typical response take?

Most enquiries receive a response within 24 hours during business hours. Urgent issues are addressed by end of business the same day. Simple questions via portal chat are usually answered within 2-4 hours.
Can I schedule a call with my consultant?
Yes. Book a free consultation or email us with preferred times. Enterprise clients can request their dedicated account liaison to schedule.
Do you offer weekend or after-hours support?
Standard support is Monday-Friday 9 AM-5 PM AEST. Enterprise clients have after-hours emergency contact. For scheduled projects outside business hours, contact us to arrange.
How do I track my support request?
Service clients can track status in the Client Portal under Support Tickets. Email enquiries receive a reference number for tracking. Training students can message via the student dashboard.
What if I do not hear back within the promised time?
Contact us directly at +61 460 003 494 or email info@solbusinessconsultant.com.au with URGENT in the subject line. We take response commitments seriously.

What are the 12 modules and how long does each take?

The 12 modules cover: (1) Introduction to the NDIS, (2) Role & Responsibilities of a Support Coordinator, (3) NDIS Practice Standards & Code of Conduct, (4) Plan Implementation & Budget Management, (5) Goal Setting & Participant-Centred Practice, (6) Stakeholder & Provider Coordination, (7) Documentation & Reporting Requirements, (8) Risk Management & Incident Response, (9) Complex Needs & Specialist Support Coordination, (10) Cultural Safety & Diversity, (11) Workforce Development & Self-Care, and (12) Audit Readiness & Continuous Improvement. Each module is designed for approximately 2–3 hours of self-paced learning, totalling 24–36 hours across the full curriculum.
